import json
r=json.load(open('/app/recovered.json'))
print('count:',len(r))
print('ids:',[x['id'] for x in r])
print('types ok:',all(isinstance(x['id'],int) and isinstance(x['name'],str) and isinstance(x['value'],int) for x in r))
print('first/last:',r[0],r[-1])
" && echo "--- pristine encrypted WAL preserved ---" && head -c 4 main.db-wal.original.enc | od -A n -t x1 && ls -l main.db-wal.original.enc && echo "--- scratch db+wal read ---" && rm -rf /tmp/finalcheck && mkdir -p /tmp/finalcheck && cp main.db main.db-wal /tmp/finalcheck/ && python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/finalcheck/main.db'); c.execute('pragma wal_autocheckpoint=0')
print('rows:',[r for r in c.execute('select id,name,value from items order by id')])
print('integrity:', c.execute('pragma integrity_check').fetchone())
c.close()"
